# Pinned Kusto source evidence

This directory contains exact source snapshots used by deterministic Go
generators and provenance checks. They are not compiled or loaded at runtime.

`DiagnosticFacts.cs` is copied unchanged from
`src/Kusto.Language/Diagnostics/DiagnosticFacts.cs` at commit
`6b5c2f739a14bd5de52115f9bf9695985f0852dd` of Microsoft's
`Kusto-Query-Language` repository. Its SHA-256 is recorded in
`third_party/kusto/UPSTREAM.json`.

The snapshot is distributed under the Apache License 2.0 preserved at
`third_party/kusto/LICENSE`.
